seams: ORGANIZATION_PLANS (operator allowlist filled at run time)

testOnly.passkeys: soft passkeys per person (tests/helpers/soft-passkey.mjs) behind navigator.credentials; real adapter verification
testOnly.turnstile: third-party stand-in for Cloudflare Turnstile (widget script and siteverify), tokens bound to host and action, single use
testOnly.tls: per-run local CA; browsers ignore certificate errors; servers trust only the run CA
testOnly.network: DNS and socket replaced at the providers' injection seams; screening unchanged
testOnly.addresses: each person browses through their own proxy port carrying a seeded address, passed to providers in the operator trusted client-IP header (TRUSTED_CLIENT_IP_HEADER)
testOnly.clock: real time (see gaps: a frozen browser clock breaks DPoP proof iat checks against real-time providers)

caveat: Self-consistency, not interoperability: every provider here shares authors.

expect.pending: A member homed on beta cannot join an organization on alpha: POST /api/orgs/{id}/accept resolves the organization on the person's own host (accountHandle), and the certificate-based acceptance (input.admit, packages/orgs/certificates.mjs) has no route.
expect.rule: organizations rev 4.5 §5 foreign members; packages/runtime/routes/orgs.mjs accept

steps.error: A member on beta.example could not join an organization on another provider (refused: This organization is not available to you.).

expect.pending: The second.example member never joined (no foreign acceptance route) and the organization has no connection to Board (organizations have no app authorization flow), so the organization answers invalid_grant to a valid foreign member certificate.

steps.error: The organization refused the second.example member's certificate: 400 invalid_grant.

expect.pending: The certificate exchange at the organization's token endpoint answers invalid_grant: the organization has no live app connection or grant for Board, and no flow creates one (tests seed both in storage).

steps.error: No member-context token: Board is in "pending" (not-connected).

expect.pending: The organization chooser is designed, not built: Board asks for the organization's address instead (OC-5 fallback).

steps.error: <bindle-session> offers no organization context choice (no `entity` attribute).

expect.pending: Relations between organizations on different providers are refused: counterparty lookup resolves local organizations only and the ORG-11 relation transport is unimplemented (relation_foreign_unavailable).

steps.error: The counterparty n.3s@beta.example did not resolve: 404 counterparty_unavailable.
